Coram : Sri Ananda Sen, J
---------
 For the Petitioner: Mr. Amit Kumar, Advocate
 For the State: Mr. Arup Kr. Dey, A.P.P.
 ---------
04/ Dated: 16.05.2024
The petitioner, who is accused for the offence punishable under Sections 498A/323/494 of the Ipc
and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, is praying for grant of regular bail, as he is in custody
since 12.03.2024.

entities.text: High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard the learned counsel for the parties.
Learned APP opposes the prayer for bail.
This case arises out of a complaint case.
The petitioner after his anticipatory bail was rejected by this Court has appeared and surrendered before the Trial Court.
Thereafter not only trial court has rejected his regular bail but the same has been rejected by Sessions Judge also.

In a complaint case when the accused appears before the trial court order should be passed in terms of the judgment passed by this Court in the case of Birendra Jha @ Virendra Jha Vrs. State of Jharkhand,

entities.text: Birendra Jha @ Virendra Jha Vrs. State of Jharkhand
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is surprising that the aforesaid judgement till date is not being followed by the Trial court.
The Trial Court thus needs to be sensitized by the Judicial Academy, Ranchi on this issue.
Considering the fact that this case arises out of complaint case and the petitioner has surrendered, I am inclined to allow this application.

Accordingly, the petitioner above named is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten Thousand) with two sureties of Raj Kumar Mahto vs State Of Jharkhand on 16 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/185459376/
